oral_examination.oral_examination: 11 The crown of the tooth is dark gray, there is no difference when tapping the (-) gums, and it is loose to the first degree. The gums were locally red and swollen, but there was no bleeding during probing, and no periodontal pockets, dental calculus, or pigments were detected. CBCT showed: 11 apical low-density shadow had clear borders, the root canal was thick, and the apical foramen was not closed.

diagnosis.primary: 11 Apical cyst and apical foramen are not closed. Gingivitis

treatment_plan.definitive: 1 Root canal treatment and re-establishing the apical barrier, regular observation after treatment, and elective apical cyst removal. The patient was informed of the cost and treatment plan, and the patient gave informed consent. Ultrasonic teeth cleaning
treatment_plan.notes: Routine medical advice and follow-up consultation if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: 1. Open the pulp, dredge the root canal, flush the root canal with normal saline, apply rubber dam, ultrasonic cleaning with 1% sodium hypochlorite, dry by moisture, put CP iodoform cotton twist drainage into the root canal, and temporarily seal the ZOE. Ultrasonic teeth cleaning and polishing
